episode.title: Something Is WRONG With This LEMON

synopsis: A man slices open a fresh lemon to find a tiny, impossibly deep stone spiral staircase inside, flowing water down into the void.
narration: I was slicing lemons for tea yesterday when I saw this. My landlord thinks I'm losing my mind, but how does this even fit in here?

shots.prompt: A large bright yellow lemon with a thick textured rind and a small green stem attached The frame remains completely locked from a slightly elevated top-down angle over the kitchen counter. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. A pair of hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt slices the yellow lemon in half with a silver knife. The interior reveals a tiny, ancient stone spiral staircase curving down into a dark hollow space.
